scope: Local exploratory evaluation, not release acceptance

method.wall_s: Fresh process including model load, decode, separation and float-WAV writes; downloads, compilation and metrics excluded
method.memory: macOS /usr/bin/time -l; bytes; RSS and footprint are different accounting measures
method.sdr_db: 10 log10(sum(reference^2)/sum((estimate-reference)^2)); stereo whole-signal, no fitting; not BSSEval
method.precision: demucs-rs converted F16 weights; Charon downloadable in-graph F32 ONNX
method.cpu_control: demucs-cli --features cpu (Burn NdArray<f32>), one run per control
method.probe_limit: Silence and rate48 correctness probes overlapped the CPU build and are not timing comparisons
method.analysis_frames: input_frames and stems.frames count FFmpeg metric samples at 44.1 kHz; original file rate/frames are input_stream and stems.stream metadata
method.ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 8.1.2 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers

inputs.archive_entry: test/James Elder & Mark M Thompson - The English Actor.stem.mp4

limits: Five test excerpts only; AAC-derived references
No blind listening, full-song corpus or local PyTorch parity evaluation
No optimized Charon split/CoreML export, Windows/Linux execution or playback contention test
No complete transitive-license or vulnerability audit; model permission remains unresolved
